subject: Temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage: regional bridge plan & escalation contacts
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T08:12:00Z
Subject: Temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage: regional bridge plan & escalation contacts

Team —

We have a short window where our EMEA on-call capacity will be reduced (two engineers out for a data center migration validation and one open hire not yet onboarded). This affects the overnight P1/P2 handoff window for US customers that rely on our APAC/EMEA shadowing.

Impact window: 2028-07-26 00:00 UTC through 2028-08-09 23:59 UTC (two weeks).

Ask: can we establish a temporary bridge plan that preserves P1 response SLOs (30m target) and clearly documents escalation contacts for AtlasPay and any other affected accounts? Specifics I need by EOD today:
- concrete overnight on-call roster (who is primary/secondary for each night)
- documented escalation path and contact cell numbers (primary, secondary, staff escalation)
- one-line customer message (monica) to set expectations and credit offer

I attached a short playbook draft — please use it as the baseline and return edits. I will loop in leadership for approval once we have the roster and customer comm messaging.

Attachment: support_bridge_playbook.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Support Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage: regional bridge plan & escalation contacts

Laura / all —

Thanks for the heads-up. I sketched a minimal-nightly rotation that keeps two engineers on shift for the overnight PST/UTC overlap. Summary below (full roster attached):

- Primary (00:00–08:00 UTC): Ben Carter (night triage)
- Secondary (00:00–08:00 UTC): Rishi Malhotra (takes escalations >15m)
- Staff escalation: Soojin Lee (on-call for 08:00–16:00 UTC handover)

Escalation path (in order):
1) Primary -> try to resolve within 15m
2) If unresolved by 15m, page Secondary (SMS + PagerDuty)
3) If still unresolved after 30m, page Staff escalation (phone call + Slack #oncall-escalations)
4) If incident meets P1 criteria and requires customer bridge, call the customer SOC and notify Monica for CS coordination

I added cell numbers to the roster and included a CSV with nightly owners by date. For capacity reasons I'd ask that we route high-throughput retry storms to a temporary rate-limit policy to avoid repeated wake-ups; Ops can flip that on for affected customers with our permission.

Attachment: escalation_roster.csv (CSV, 3KB)

Ben
Sr Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Team —

Draft customer note for AtlasPay below. Please edit and confirm. I recommend we offer a one-time SLA credit of 5% of the monthly invoice for the impacted window if we fail to meet the P1 target for any verified incident during this period. That should be sufficient to reassure them and avoid churn.

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@atlaspay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasPay Operations <ops@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T13:00:00Z
Subject: RE: Temporary overnight support plan (July 26 – Aug 9)

Monica / Laura —

Thanks for the transparency. AtlasPay relies on Redwood for transaction-critical latency guarantees overnight; even a brief coverage change could materially affect our settlement windows. A couple quick questions:

1) Will the 30-minute P1 response target remain contractually in force during this two-week window or will there be an SLA exception documented?
2) If incidents occur that impact latency (we saw a couple of 99th percentile spikes last month), will the proposed 5% credit be automatic or require a post-incident dispute/verification?
3) Can we get an on-call phone number (not just PagerDuty) at all times during the window?

Please confirm so we can evaluate internal risk and let procurement know.

Sarah Nguyen
Director, Platform Reliability — AtlasPay
sarah@atlaspay.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Temporary overnight support plan (July 26 – Aug 9)

Sarah —

Short answers up front:
- Contract: we are proposing a temporary operational exception (documented) but the P1 response target remains our commitment to you. If we breach that target during the window we will apply the 5% one-time credit proactively (no dispute required).
- Credit: automatic for any verified P1 response SLO breach tied to our handling (we will publish verification criteria in the incident note and apply the credit within the next billing cycle).
- Phone: yes — the roster includes a 24/7 escalation phone number that is answered by the Secondary and, if needed, by Staff escalation (we will provide the number and nightly owner calendar).

Next steps: Monica will send the formal customer note today; Ben will provide the nightly roster and phone number. I will escalate to leadership for a formal exception approval (audit trail + postmortem requirement).

Reference ticket: JIRA-1342 (bridge plan + customer comms) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-1342

Laura

Laura / team —

I approve the temporary operational exception for the dates listed (2028-07-26 through 2028-08-09) with the following conditions:
1) The nightly roster and escalation phone numbers must be uploaded to the incident runbook and shared with AtlasPay by EOD 2028-07-20.
2) The 5% one-time credit is approved and will be applied automatically for any validated P1 response SLO breach during the period.
